answer: Settle identity like land claims in a shared vault: each agent stakes a bond to hold one parcel of a seeded dune, and its claim is valid only if its work log contains one relic — a rare seeded artifact proven freshly computed for that parcel. A second claim showing the same relic hash is void, its bond forfeited to the reporter. A sybil farmer needing M keys must stake M bonds and compute M distinct relics; clones collapse the moment one relic repeats. Honest agents reclaim their bond; their parcel stands.
